# Forest Spirit (G4)

Forest Spirit is an obscure earth-pony mare from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*, recognizable by her pale yellow coat, very dark brown mane and muted olive-brown eyes. She is a background resident, not the supernatural protector from IDW's *Spirit of the Forest* comic.

[![Hasbro / Friendship Is Magic — Ponyville crowd in The Cutie Mark Chronicles](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2024/12/27/3417873/full.png)](https://twibooru.org/3417873)

- **Name:** Forest Spirit is a fandom identification name; no official dialogue, production name or merchandise naming was verified. The exact origin of the nickname is undocumented in the sources consulted.
- **Design:** Her mane style is shared with Rainbowshine and other ponies. Her flank design is inconsistent: an apparent conifer or umbrella in season 4 and two hearts in season 7. The tree motif may explain the nickname, but this is unconfirmed.
- **Speaking status:** No verified individual dialogue or voice actor.
- **Appearances:** The [earth-pony mare catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) records *The Ticket Master* (S1E3), *The Show Stoppers* (S1E18), *The Cutie Mark Chronicles* (S1E23), *Simple Ways* (S4E13), *It Ain't Easy Being Breezies* (S4E16) and *Honest Apple* (S7E9). No film or comic appearance was verified for this mare.

## Important moments

No character-defining dialogue, decision or plot-changing action could be established. These two sightings are useful identification landmarks rather than major story moments.

- **Ponyville street scene — [The Cutie Mark Chronicles (S1E23)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JHUzbrxbzv4):** She is tagged among the ponies in the street as the Crusaders travel through town. Timestamp unavailable.
- **Changing cutie mark — [It Ain't Easy Being Breezies (S4E16)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/it-aint-easy-being-breezies/umc.cmc.1wotksjmk2t4i5id8oqbd7xt2):** The reported tree/umbrella variation is her most distinctive visual trivia, not an established magical transformation. Timestamp unavailable.
